description: Marine Infrastructure and Vessels 1860-2006 is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Queensland State Archives. This series held at Queensland State Archives, comprises drawings of Queensland harbour infrastructure, including wharves, jetties, breakwaters, harbour roadworks and drainage, harbour buildings, storage, cranes and other loading facilities including those for coal, sugar and livestock, accommodation including cottages, offices and workshops, wharf railways and tramways, slipways and winches, boat ramps, dolphins and buoys and ... Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Queensland State Archives. Its tags are Queensland State Archives, historical, infrastructure, marine, vessel. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal shows 2025-11-11 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
